name: B-Day-25
storyline:
Spend three days celebrating a birthday with your former patient who is keeping you confined.

Your choices may lead you toward happiness.

Why is your former patient keeping you here?
And why do you not want to leave?

Beyond trauma and birthdays…
perhaps there is nothing left but love.
summary:
B-Day-25 is an Another World story set in the WithoutEyes series.

It tells the story of someone who wanted to save another person,
and someone who relied too deeply on that kindness.

A destructive brotherhood drama shaped by guilt, blame, and emotional dependence.
